headline: Alice Huang maintained contact with Chinese espionage agency for more than a year
summary: The New York Times reported that Alice Huang, at the centre of a recent Nvidia scandal, kept in contact with an official of China's main intelligence agency for more than a year. The report says she was in a close relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI chips, and its China business is closely watched amid US-China tensions. Security controversies can affect regulatory scrutiny and sales access.
original_headline: Alice Huang mantuvo contacto con la agencia de espionaje china durante más de un año
